1Yeh method kaise kaam karta hai

YouTube par "What If" cartoon channels lakhon views la rahe hain: ek stick-figure hero, shaam jaisi lighting wale kamre, fast cuts, aur ek narrator jo seedha aapse baat karta hai.

Sabse badi baat: character kisi AI image/video model se generate nahi hota, woh code hai. Claude use ek baar code me likhta hai, isliye har shot me character bilkul same dikhta hai. Koi "drift" nahi, chehra nahi badalta.

Aapka 1 idea→Claude: script→Voice: ElevenLabs / AI33 Pro / FameSpeak→Claude: storyboard + check→Remotion: video render
Yeh smart kyun hai?

Agar koi shot galat bana, to bas code ki ek line badlo aur dobara render karo, bilkul free.

3Setup: step by step

Setup sirf ek baar karna hota hai, lagbhag 15–20 minute lagte hain. Kuch bhi haath se install nahi karna, Claude Code khud karega. Bas steps isi order me follow karo.

Part APC ke zaroori tools (sabse pehle)

Animation skill chalane ke liye PC me yeh tools hone chahiye. Beginners ko aksar pata nahi hota, isliye pehle Claude se yeh install karwao:

ToolKis kaam ka
Node.jsRemotion (video render) isi par chalta hai
PythonAudio aur helper scripts ke liye
FFmpegAudio/video jodna aur convert karna
GitGitHub se skill download karne ke liye
Whisper (light "base" model)Voiceover se word-by-word timestamps, subtitles aur scene sync ke liye
Whisper ka light model kaafi hai

Timestamps ke liye chhota "base" model achha kaam karta hai. Yeh baat prompt me likhi hai, warna Claude bada (kai GB ka) model download kar sakta hai jo time aur space dono khaata hai.

  1. Claude Code kholo (terminal ya desktop app) ek nayi khaali folder me.
  2. Pehle yeh prompt paste karo. Yeh PC check karke jo missing hai woh install karega:
    Prompt 1 · PC tools
    Check my PC and install everything I need for video animation work. Check if these are installed: Node.js (LTS), Python 3, FFmpeg, Git, and OpenAI Whisper (for word timestamps). Install whatever is missing (on Windows use winget and pip, on Mac use Homebrew and pip) and make sure each one is added to PATH. For Whisper, download only the lightweight "base" model. Do not download the medium or large models. When done, verify each tool by showing its version.
    Agar Claude koi permission maange to "Yes" karo. Windows par ek-do baar "Allow / Yes" ka popup aa sakta hai.
  3. Check karo sab install hua ya nahi. Yeh prompt paste karo:
    Prompt · Check
    Show me the versions of Node.js, Python, FFmpeg, Git and Whisper to confirm everything is installed.
Agar kuch fail ho jaye

Claude ko error dikhakar bas likho: "This failed, please fix it and try again." Woh khud doosra tarika try karega.

Part BWhat If skill install karo

  1. Ab yeh prompt paste karo:
    Prompt 2 · Skill
    Install the What If skill from github.com/kelano86/what-if-animation, then set up its studio and everything it needs.
    Claude skill download karke Remotion studio set up kar dega. Permission maange to "Yes" karte jao.

Part CVoice API key

  1. Voice ki API key banao. Jo tool aap use karte ho, uski key lo:
    ToolKey kahan milegi.env me naam
    ElevenLabselevenlabs.io → Settings → API KeysELEVENLABS_API_KEY
    AI33 ProAI33 Pro dashboard → API / API Key sectionAI33_API_KEY
    FameSpeakFameSpeak dashboard → API / API Key sectionFAMESPEAK_API_KEY
  2. Key save karo. Project folder me .env file banao aur sirf woh line rakho jo tool aap use karte ho:
    .env file
    ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=yahan_apni_elevenlabs_key
AI33_API_KEY=yahan_apni_ai33_pro_key
FAMESPEAK_API_KEY=yahan_apni_famespeak_key
  3. Claude ko batao kaunsa voice tool use karna hai (sirf AI33 Pro ya FameSpeak wale):
    Prompt 3 · AI33 Pro
    For voiceover, use AI33 Pro instead of ElevenLabs. My API key is saved as AI33_API_KEY in the .env file. Update the What If skill's voice step to use it.
    Prompt 3 · FameSpeak
    For voiceover, use FameSpeak instead of ElevenLabs. My API key is saved as FAMESPEAK_API_KEY in the .env file. Update the What If skill's voice step to use it.

Part DTest

  1. Test karo: Claude se kaho ki skill ke saath aane wale dono example episodes, Rewind aur CopyPaste, play kare. Agar dono chal gaye, aap ready ho!
Note

Skill officially ElevenLabs ke saath aati hai. AI33 Pro / FameSpeak ke liye Claude upar wale prompt se voice step adjust kar deta hai. Pehle ek chhota test episode bana ke awaaz check kar lo. Sound effects ke liye bhi wahi tool chal sakta hai agar woh SFX support karta ho, warna ElevenLabs SFX use karo.

Dhyan rahe

API key kabhi kisi ke saath share na karein, screenshot me na dikhayein, aur .env file GitHub par upload na karein.

4Pehla episode banao

Setup ke baad Claude ko bas ek line deni hai:

Prompt · Episode
Make a What If episode: what if you never had to sleep?

Iske baad Claude apne aap:

  1. Script likhta hai
  2. Aapke voice tool (ElevenLabs / AI33 Pro / FameSpeak) se voiceover banwata hai
  3. Har shot ka storyboard banata hai
  4. Apni hi images check karta hai aur galtiyan theek karta hai
  5. Animate karta hai aur sound effects jodta hai
Real result

Video me "sleep" wala episode lagbhag 40 minute me bana, aur usme haath se kuch bhi edit nahi kiya gaya. Apna topic badalne ke liye bas "what if..." ke baad apna idea likh do.

5Kisi style ko match karna

Sirf ek simple prompt se ~16 minute me decent pehla version ban gaya tha, lekin woh bahut basic dikhta tha. Fark lamba prompt likhne se nahi, balki ek method follow karne se aaya:

1. Original ko measure karo→2. Rules likho→3. Character ek baar banao→4. Storyboard + image check→5. Animate sabse last

Prompt A: video ko copy nahi, measure karwao

Reference video Claude ko do aur yeh kaho:

Prompt A · Measure
Here's a video. Don't copy it, measure it: how often it cuts, where the light comes from, how much the characters move. Write every rule down.

Example: original video ke opening me ~27 cuts per minute the, pehle version me sirf 14. Aise likhe hue rules hi Claude agli baar follow karta hai.

Prompt B: sabse important wala

Ek still image seconds me render hoti hai, video minutes me. Isliye pehle har shot ko image ke roop me perfect karo:

Prompt B · Image check
Render every shot as an image. Look at each one like a viewer would. List what looks wrong, and fix it before you animate anything.

Is check ne galat dikhti seedhiyan (stairs) aur hood ke peeche chhupa haath animation se pehle hi pakad liye.

Quality 4/10 se 8/10 tak le jaane wali cheezein
  • Image check (Prompt B) har shot par
  • Kamre real perspective me draw hon
  • Light lamp aur khidki se aaye (natural source)
  • Har shot me naya camera angle

6Viral "What If" story formula

Sirf look nahi, story bhi utni hi zaroori hai. 4 channels ki 5 scripts ek hi pattern follow karti hain, aur skill me yeh template ke roop me pehle se hai. Bas brackets bharo:

0
Title: WHAT IF [aapki power]?
1
Cold open: seedha action ke beech se shuru karo. Power ke 3-4 quick demo, ya climax ka flash-forward.
2
Premise aur rules: raaton-raat kya badla, aur uske rules kya hain.
3
Maze wala hissa: roz ki zindagi me badhti hui jeet.
4
Problem wala hissa: iski keemat, ek sach, verified fact aur number ke saath.
5
Koi powerful notice karta hai: suit wala aadmi, chor, ya sarkar.
6
Moral choice, family khatre me: aksar ek chhoti behen.
7
Cliffhanger: comments ke liye sawaal, ya "Part 1 of 2".

Example: "Reactions 10x fast" episode

Shuruaat ek makkhi aur coffee cup se. Aapke reactions 10 guna tez ho jaate hain, aur aap sports genius ban jaate ho. (Real fact: normal insaan ka reaction time lagbhag 0.25 second hota hai.) Phir World Cup final… aur teen din baad, ek kaali gaadi.

Secret sauce

Story ke andar ek sach fact hona chahiye. Viewer kuch real seekhta hai, isliye video "AI slop" jaisi feel nahi hoti.

7Kharcha (cost)

Item20-second episode
Claude Code (script + har shot)$100/month plan me koi extra kharcha nahi
Voice + SFX (ElevenLabs)~ $0.12
Voice (AI33 Pro / FameSpeak)Apne plan / credits ke hisaab se
Remotion (render)Free
$20 plan wale dhyan dein

Episode banana Claude ke liye bada kaam hai. $20 plan par usage limit hit ho sakti hai, aur kaam ek-do resets me pura hoga. Lambe (jaise 7-minute) episode ke liye part-by-part banao, same characters aur rooms ke saath, aur last me Claude se saare parts jodwa lo.

8Kya YouTube ise AI content bolke flag karega?

YouTube ke monetisation rules mass-produced aur repetitive videos ko target karte hain, AI ko nahi. Isliye:

  • Skill ke example episodes (ya kisi aur ke) copy-paste karke upload mat karo.
  • Apna khud ka character banao aur use ek personality do.
  • Apna brand banao. Channel tool se nahi, aapki originality se banta hai.
